name: Day 01 Reflections on Acts
observations: I rely on my own strength or understanding when I get panicked. I tend to get into my own understanding even though I know God is always in control.
What I want to be is more intentional in what I pray for and practice discipling myself to the extent that when a panic situation comes, I will by default trust in God.
Being intentional in prayer and being disciplined is our surrender to the Spirit so that the nature of Jesus Christ can be formed in us and become our first nature bit by bit.
We may never be perfect on this side of Heaven and that's why Paul's statements seem contradictory in Romans 7 and 8.
There is no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus. He has paid for our past present and future sins.
That does not give us a licence to sin intentionally but when we fall and then confess our sins repentantly, there is no condemnation for us.
God does not punish the same sins that Jesus died for twice.
Thank you Jesus.

name: Day 02 Reflections on Acts
observations: The disciples were focused on the final outcome but Jesus wanted them to focus on the journey and follow on His example and along the way spread the good news and gave them/us power to do so through His Spirit.
Knowing this, still the end result (various fears of the future) distracts me from carrying on His mission most of the time. Trust, Surrender and obedience is the key.
My friends and colleagues need to hear about Christ but more than hearing they should see Christ through my conduct.
Thank you Jesus.

observations: The disciples were focused on the final outcome but Jesus wanted them to focus on the journey and follow His example

Friends and colleagues need to hear about Christ but more importantly see Christ through my conduct

name: Day 3 and 4 Reflections
observations: Consistency in prayer requires being intentional in prayers for ourselves and others
Believe in what we pray and have a heart for the person we pray for as if praying for ourselves
Praying for others cultivates unity amongst believers
I do not seek God in every decision now - everyday decisions often feel automatic
Jesus made every decision with the Father
Must ask the Holy Spirit to put the nature of Christ in me
Need to be conformed to Christ's nature and walk with total dependence on the Father/Holy Spirit's guidance
This total dependence is how I can be faithful to my Creator

name: Day 5 Reflections
observations: I do live with awareness of God's presence but my actions do not always follow my awareness
This happens when loaded with work or preoccupied with my own way of doing things
To be more sensitive to the Holy Spirit, I need to let go of my own way even if it seems efficient
I need to be still in thoughts in His presence and surrender my ideas and plans for the day to Him
